feat(diagnostics): renderToString and renderTemplate render theme names and report bad styles (rich-diagnostics-t782) (#298)

* feat(diagnostics): renderToString and renderTemplate render theme names and report bad styles the way Console does (rich-diagnostics-t782)

renderToString takes a theme, so strict onStyleError holds for themed
content. renderTemplate takes theme and onStyleError; only compile and
evaluate sit inside its try, so a rethrown style error leaves the call
instead of becoming an [error: ...] segment.

* fix(diagnostics): renderTemplate keeps its doc, takes RenderOptions' fields so a wrapping renderable forwards them whole, and its docs say what a theme reaches (rich-diagnostics-t782)

* fix(template-bindings): flattening a template's output stays inside renderTemplate's try, so an unflattenable scope value is an [error: …] line again (rich-diagnostics-t782)

* fix(template-bindings): renderTemplate takes RenderOptions whole, so a wrapping renderable's justify, overflow and the rest reach the render (rich-diagnostics-t782)
